units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣无微不至地替玉鬘打算：

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, considered Tamakazura's future with the utmost care:

units.source_text: 如何可以使她前途幸福。

en.t: how he might make her future a happy one.

units.source_text: 然而他心中那个“无声瀑布”使得玉鬘悲伤忧恼。

en.t: Yet the silent waterfall in his heart filled Tamakazura with sorrow and distress.

units.source_text: 紫姬早就推量，果然不出所料。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had guessed this long ago, and it turned out just as she had expected.

units.source_text: 此事可使源氏蒙受轻薄的恶名。

en.t: This affair could bring Genji the disgraceful reputation of being frivolous.
He himself had once reflected on it as well:

units.source_text: 内大臣秉性直率，无论何事都察察为明，小小的不满也不能容忍。

en.t: The Minister of the Center is naturally forthright; in everything he insists on perfect clarity, and he cannot tolerate even the slightest dissatisfaction.

units.source_text: 万一他查明此事，便不加斟酌，公然以女婿相待，则我安得不被天下人取笑？

en.t: If he should discover this matter, he would make no allowance for discretion and openly treat me as his son-in-law; how could I avoid becoming the laughingstock of the world?
